name: fabflows
description: Routes work from an expensive lead model to tool-scoped workers and makes the lead re-verify their reports. Adds a build loop in a git worktree where Opus builders implement a spec (independent tasks at once) and fresh reviewers return ACCEPT or REWORK, and brainstorming for that spec. Tickets and trace reports are in fabflows-tickets. An ACTIVE guard hook asks before package installs and blocks default-branch commits, destructive commands and credential-file access. It fails open.
